cli.rationale: Terminal client. Scope: OpenCode desktop beta, OpenCode terminal runtime, OpenCode iPhone TestFlight remote, OpenCode shared server and HTTP API.

opencode.rationale: OpenCode provides its own agent runtime with configurable model providers. Scope: OpenCode desktop beta, OpenCode terminal runtime, OpenCode iPhone TestFlight remote, OpenCode shared server and HTTP API.

claude-code.rationale: The shipped local Claude Agent plugin launches the installed Claude Code CLI through its official SDK, persists/resumes Claude sessions and manages the process. OpenCode supplies tools/permissions/compaction/subagents; Claude builtin tools/settings and remote workspaces are excluded.

codex.rationale: The supplied registry has OpenCode and native Claude Agent session execution; the other named entries are model-provider API routes. The bounded shipped registry has no supplied session adapter for this harness.

local.rationale: Computer-hosted service. Scope: OpenCode desktop beta, OpenCode terminal runtime, OpenCode iPhone TestFlight remote, OpenCode shared server and HTTP API.

own-server.rationale: Explicit server URL is supported; remote host setup was not exercised. Scope: OpenCode desktop beta, OpenCode terminal runtime, OpenCode iPhone TestFlight remote, OpenCode shared server and HTTP API.

worktree.rationale: Desktop worktree selection is documented. Scope: OpenCode desktop beta, OpenCode terminal runtime, OpenCode iPhone TestFlight remote, OpenCode shared server and HTTP API.

parallel-runs.rationale: Concurrent sessions. Scope: OpenCode desktop beta.

coordinator.rationale: OpenCode supplies its own parent agent with a child-session delegation tool, agent/model selection, returned results and follow-up messaging by session ID.

review.note: The only cited evidence (nov07-agents) shows delegation to subagents with their own permissions, but not that the coordinator can inspect or message them. That half is in gap-tools (results come back to the foreground; a background run returns a sessionID that can be prompted again), which COORD-03 cites and this mapping does not; add gap-tools and the value would stand.

review-ui.rationale: File diffs. Scope: OpenCode desktop beta.

license.rationale: MIT, subject to component notices. Scope: OpenCode desktop beta, OpenCode terminal runtime, OpenCode shared server and HTTP API.

self-hosting.rationale: Shared or standalone local service. Scope: OpenCode terminal runtime, OpenCode shared server and HTTP API.

web-client.rationale: Released web UI is served from OpenCode runtime server and paired through expiring login link.

free-tier.rationale: Product FAQ explicitly states OpenCode is free to use, with included free models.

starting-price.rationale: Core application free; external providers and optional model subscriptions excluded.

roles.rationale: Console workspace roles Member/Admin/Owner have documented management and removal rules. This does not add roles to a local runtime.

sso.rationale: Console includes OIDC/SAML workspace SSO; local runtime auth remains separate.

unattended-triggers.rationale: Official V2 CLI example uses an external GitHub Actions pull_request event to start a standalone run. User configures CI; this is not a native scheduler.

no-paid-plan.rationale: Core OpenCode explicitly free; separate model plans excluded.

free-plan.rationale: The complete core OpenCode application is explicitly free. Optional Console/Go model plans and provider token/compute charges are separately sold model access, not paid ADE application plans.

issue-tracking.rationale: The bounded native core implements per-session todo tool state, without a separate cross-session issue/backlog work-item store.

pr-workflow.rationale: The available stable V1 GitHub App/Action implements a branch and submits a PR via the GitHub API. This receipt is explicitly V1 integration scope, not the V2 desktop command set.

laptop-independent.rationale: The same runtime can run on a user-operated always-on remote host while clients connect over the network. That host, rather than the controlling laptop, executes work.
